column1: # Held-out evaluation set: latin <TAB> expected Devanagari <TAB> tags
# Hand-written, never generated from the engine or from `xlit-dict`'s seed —
# a set produced by round-tripping the transliterator would only prove the
# transliterator agrees with itself. Each row is what a person would type and
# Tags are comma-separated; the harness reports a score per tag.
#   casual  — typed the way people actually type: no capitals for retroflexes,
#             no doubled vowels for length. Recovering the spelling from this is
#   strict  — spelled out in the schema's ITRANS conventions, which the rule
#   core / loan / proper / inflect — vocabulary group.
# The rule engine transliterates letter by letter and cannot know that "hello"
# is written हेलो and not हेल्लो; only the dictionary can.
# ---- the same language spelled in the schema's own conventions ---------------
# No dictionary needed: if these are wrong, the rule engine is wrong.
